## Featured Products
- [BPC-157](https://peptidesourcehub.net/products/bpc-157/): Gastric pentadecapeptide, CAS 137525-51-0, ~1419.5 Da, healing & tissue repair
- [TB-500](https://peptidesourcehub.net/products/tb-500/): Thymosin Beta-4 fragment, CAS 77591-33-4, cell migration research
- [Semaglutide](https://peptidesourcehub.net/products/semaglutide/): GLP-1 receptor agonist, CAS 910463-68-2, ~4113.6 Da, metabolic research
- [Tirzepatide](https://peptidesourcehub.net/products/tirzepatide/): Dual GIP/GLP-1 agonist, CAS 2023788-19-2, ~4813.5 Da
- [Cagrilintide](https://peptidesourcehub.net/products/cagrilintide/): Long-acting amylin analogue, CAS 2489551-48-6, dual-pathway metabolic
- [Retatrutide](https://peptidesourcehub.net/products/retatrutide/): Triple GIP/GLP-1/GCGR agonist, CAS 2381089-83-2, next-gen metabolic
- [GHK-Cu](https://peptidesourcehub.net/products/ghk-cu/): Copper tripeptide-1, CAS 49557-75-7, collagen synthesis & skin research
- [HGH](https://peptidesourcehub.net/products/hgh/): Human Growth Hormone, CAS 12629-01-5, ~22125 Da, GH/IGF-1 axis research
